`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

    generate
        if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
            wire [255:0] winner;
            pe_radix4_msb #(.N(256), .E(8)) tree (
                .x(input_unencoded),
                .v(output_valid),
                .c(output_encoded),
                .h(winner)
            );
            assign output_unencoded = winner | {{255{1'b0}}, ~output_valid};
        end else begin : original_behavior
            wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
            wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
            wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
            genvar l, n;
            for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
                assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_pair
                    assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
                end else begin : msb_pair
                    assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
                end
            end
            for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
                for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                    assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                    if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_select
                        assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                            stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                            {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                            {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                    end else begin : msb_select
                        assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                            stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                            {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                            {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                    end
                end
            end
            assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
            assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
            assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

// Internal helper: N is a power of four, E is log2(N).
// Both c and h are zero when x is zero.
module pe_radix4_msb #(
    parameter N = 4,
    parameter E = 2
)(
    input wire [N-1:0] x,
    output wire v,
    output wire [E-1:0] c,
    output wire [N-1:0] h
);
    generate
        if (N == 4) begin : leaf
            wire allow2;
            wire allow1;
            wire allow0;
            assign allow2 = ~x[3];
            assign allow1 = ~(|x[3:2]);
            assign allow0 = ~(|x[3:1]);
            assign v = |x;
            assign c[1] = |x[3:2];
            assign c[0] = x[3] | (x[1] & allow1);
            assign h[3] = x[3];
            assign h[2] = x[2] & allow2;
            assign h[1] = x[1] & allow1;
            assign h[0] = x[0] & allow0;
        end else begin : branch
            localparam Q = N/4;
            wire [3:0] cv;
            wire [E-3:0] c0, c1, c2, c3;
            wire [Q-1:0] h0, h1, h2, h3;
            wire allow2;
            wire allow1;
            wire allow0;

            pe_radix4_msb #(.N(Q), .E(E-2)) child0 (
                .x(x[Q-1:0]), .v(cv[0]), .c(c0), .h(h0)
            );
            pe_radix4_msb #(.N(Q), .E(E-2)) child1 (
                .x(x[2*Q-1:Q]), .v(cv[1]), .c(c1), .h(h1)
            );
            pe_radix4_msb #(.N(Q), .E(E-2)) child2 (
                .x(x[3*Q-1:2*Q]), .v(cv[2]), .c(c2), .h(h2)
            );
            pe_radix4_msb #(.N(Q), .E(E-2)) child3 (
                .x(x[4*Q-1:3*Q]), .v(cv[3]), .c(c3), .h(h3)
            );

            assign allow2 = ~cv[3];
            assign allow1 = ~(|cv[3:2]);
            assign allow0 = ~(|cv[3:1]);
            assign v = |cv;
            assign c[E-1] = |cv[3:2];
            assign c[E-2] = cv[3] | (cv[1] & allow1);
            assign c[E-3:0] = c3 |
                (c2 & {(E-2){allow2}}) |
                (c1 & {(E-2){allow1}}) |
                (c0 & {(E-2){allow0}});

            assign h[4*Q-1:3*Q] = h3;
            assign h[3*Q-1:2*Q] = h2 & {Q{allow2}};
            assign h[2*Q-1:Q] = h1 & {Q{allow1}};
            assign h[Q-1:0] = h0 & {Q{allow0}};
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original binary hierarchy propagates low-order encoded bits through seven selection levels after pair encoding. Its one-hot output then depends on decoding the completed eight-bit result, placing encoding and decoding in series.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance to a four-level radix-4 priority tree. Compute valid flags, zero-on-empty encoded results, and actual winning-bit vectors together. Merge encoded results using parallel higher-group suppression rather than a binary mux cascade. Generate the one-hot output directly from hierarchical suppression, independently of the encoded-output decoder. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival, especially at output_unencoded, by eliminating the serial encode-to-decode path and reducing priority-selection depth. No mapped timing results are available, so a numerical gain or an improvement guarantee would be unsupported.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The implementation adds distributed winning-bit suppression and shares group-valid reductions with the encoder. This trades a global decoder for hierarchical masking. Area, buffering, maximum arrival, and electrical compliance must be measured with the specified mapping flow; compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap has not been established.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the fixed WIDTH=256, LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0 instance, the highest asserted input index wins. For an all-zero input, output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=256'b1, preserving the original nonzero default one-hot output. All two-state input patterns are covered without assumptions. Ports, parameter declarations, widths, and the original fallback expressions and truncations are retained. The design is purely combinational Verilog-2001 with elaboration-time recursion and no external dependencies. Source and mapped equivalence have not been run."
